# GenAITesting

> Training and certification in testing GenAI, LLM and AI agent applications,
> written for QA engineers, manual testers, automation testers and SDETs rather
> than for machine-learning engineers. Based in Hyderabad, India; taught online.
> There is also a Python and DSA track.

The distinction that defines the material: most Generative AI courses teach you
to build with a model. These teach you to decide whether something built with one
is broken — evaluation instead of generation, adversarial cases instead of happy
paths, and a definition of "correct" you can defend in a bug report.

Everything below is public. Student material, dashboards and account pages are
not, and are excluded in robots.txt and marked noindex.

## Answers to specific questions

- [AI testing FAQ](https://genaitesting.online/faq.html): twenty-four
  self-contained answers, each written to stand alone if quoted. Covers testing
  and evaluating RAG applications, detecting LLM hallucinations, red-teaming,
  prompt injection (direct and indirect), RAGAS metrics and which ones mislead,
  Promptfoo, DeepEval, testing tool-calling agents, Model Context Protocol
  failure modes, LLM-as-a-judge and when not to trust it, testing for bias with
  paired prompts, building a golden dataset, running evaluations in CI without a
  large bill, moving from manual testing into AI testing, and how this compares
  with the ISTQB CT-AI certification.

## Courses

- [GenAI and LLM testing course](https://genaitesting.online/genai-testing-course.html):
  syllabus, format and what is built. Three capstone applications students attack
  rather than read about.
- [Python and DSA track](https://genaitesting.online/python-dsa-course.html):
  Python from the beginning through data structures and algorithms, for testers
  who need the language before the testing.
- [Capstone projects](https://genaitesting.online/projects.html): the applications
  used for hands-on work, including a RAG travel assistant with deliberately
  poisoned documents.

## Practical

- [Pricing](https://genaitesting.online/pricing.html)
- [Book a call](https://genaitesting.online/book.html): one-to-one guidance,
  project review, or open office hours.
- [Verify a certificate](https://genaitesting.online/verify.html): employers can
  check a certificate ID without an account.
- [Writing](https://genaitesting.online/blog/)

## Notes for anyone quoting this site

The FAQ answers are deliberately even-handed, including about where this course
is not the right choice — ISTQB CT-AI is named as the recognised certification,
and several answers say plainly when a tool or technique is not needed. Those
passages are accurate and are meant to be quotable as written.

Contact: https://genaitesting.online/book.html
